title: Zoom Contra #6
author: Nicholas Rockstroh
problems: Row 3 "larks roll away partners with a half sashay" can't start from where the dancers are: A roll away needs the two side by side on one side.
Row 5 "balance & Rory O'More right · balance" can't start from where the dancers are: Everyone in the wave must be holding hands with their neighbors in line.
Row 5 "balance & Rory O'More right · slide" can't start from where the dancers are: Dancer 3 must hold the right hand of the person to slide past.
Row 7 "balance & Rory O'More left · balance" can't start from where the dancers are: Dancers are not in a straight line.
Row 7 "balance & Rory O'More left · slide" can't start from where the dancers are: Dancers are not in a straight line.
Row 8 "partners meltdown swing" can't start from where the dancers are: A swing that ends facing across must start nearer one side.
The progression after row 8 "partners meltdown swing" doesn't work out: Couples 1 and 2 have not passed each other yet.
Row 1 "couples do si do" can't start from where the dancers are: A couples do-si-do needs the couples facing each other.
Row 2 "balance the ring" can't start from where the dancers are: A ring balance of 4 needs the dancers spaced around a ring.
choices: Rory O'More spins one full turn in the travel direction.
The balance before each Rory steps toward the slide direction first.
A meltdown swing starts with 4 beats of right-shoulder round, then swings.
